D23 Propped Up | Camp Rock props with the cast of Camp Rock 3
You're going to Camp Rock! To celebrate the kickoff of the Worlds Collide Concert Tour, which brings together the worlds of Camp Rock, Descendants, and ZOMBIES in an unforgettable new arena spectacular, we teamed up with Walt Disney Archives to show the cast of Camp Rock 3 some props from the Camp Rock films! 🤩🎸🎶

Stream the Camp Rock movies on #DisneyPlus.

Tickets for the #WorldsCollideConcertTour are on sale now!
